name: 工作日历
description: 月历管理跨天任务与提醒，选择生成模型后 AI 一键生成周报/月报，按季度自动生成 OKR，接入 GitHub 与本地文件夹工作源，按周/月维护人天投入
descriptionEn: Month calendar for multi-day tasks and reminders; pick a generation model, then let AI draft weekly and monthly reports and quarterly OKRs; pull work from GitHub and local folders, and track person-days by week and month
